description: Live quiz snapshot (/api/live), shared quiz copies (/api/live/quizzes/*) and live matches (/api/live/matches/*): cache for the time their Cache-Control allows
expression: (http.host in {"1think2win.com" "www.1think2win.com"} and (http.request.uri.path eq "/api/live" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/live/quizzes/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/live/matches/")))
